snippet.title: 我的恋爱逃生攻略 Love to Live // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389200/_Love_to_Live/

《我的恋爱逃生计划》（简称《恋桃》）是一款乙女类视觉小说AVG游戏。在游戏中，您将化作误入梦境游戏的新手玩家，在危机四伏的游戏副本中与三名男主角组队，携手闯关、相识相知、情感升温。游戏内有副本探索环节和大量的剧情选项分支，您需要在其中挖掘副本阴谋的真相，甚至揭开自己的身世之
- - -
"My Love Escape Plan" (abbreviated as "Love Peach") is a otome visual novel AVG game. In the game, you will become a novice player who accidentally enters a dream game. In the dangerous game dungeon, you team up with three male protagonists, work together to overcome levels, get to know each other, and warm up your feelings. The game has dungeon exploration and a large number of plot options. You need to uncover the truth of the dungeon conspiracy and even uncover your own life experience.

Developed by 
番茄炖肉制作组
